slides.title: Read a pole before you design
A pole is a structure, not a coat hook.
slides.body: Class, height, material and owner each change what you can attach.

slides.title: Lower class, stronger pole
slides.body: Under ANSI O5.1, class is set by minimum circumference. Most telecom work meets Class 4 or Class 5 poles.

slides.title: Not all of it is above ground
slides.body: Setting depth is about 10% of length plus 2 feet. A 40 ft pole has roughly 34 ft above grade.

slides.title: Material depends on where
slides.body: US: treated pine, fir, cedar. India: pre-stressed concrete or steel. Australia: moving from hardwood to steel and concrete.

slides.title: Find the owner first
slides.body: The owner sets the rules, runs the application and charges annual rent. Check the metal tag at eye level.
